name: Toast
purpose: A transient, elevated status message that confirms an event and leaves without being answered: appears bottom-of-viewport, auto-dismisses after ~6s (paused on hover/focus), never blocks the task. The snackbar of the feedback family — Alert is its persistent in-flow sibling, Banner its page-level one. Deliberately has NO error variant: errors demand persistent attention and route to Alert.

variants.name: success
variants.use: Transient confirmation of a completed event (payment sent, message archived).

variants.name: information
variants.use: Passive notice (draft saved, new version available).

variants.name: warning
variants.use: Non-blocking caution (connection unstable). If action is required, use Alert instead.

tokens.font-family: type composites via markup class — message .t-ed-body; action .t-cm-button + .t-cm-slot
tokens.surface: tertiary/background/default (raised) + elevation/border + elevation/functional shadow (Tooltip/Modals elevation recipe, webf-011 level 1)
tokens.glyph: rag/{success,information,warning} directly on the raised surface — ≥3:1 both modes (light amber 3.02 the narrowest); marks knock out to the surface
tokens.states: action + dismiss are colour-only pending button-family partial injection (ADR-0013); hover/active = currentColor mixes 10%/16% (active > hover)

motion.reducedMotion: Entry animation removed and exit is instant under prefers-reduced-motion.

responsive.rule: Fixed 360px, max-width 100% — full-width at small viewports. Stack is a fixed bottom-left column, 8px rhythm, newest last.

mustNotNeighbour: A second toast for the same event

accessibility.role: POLITE, AT THE REGION — the page shell's toast region carries role="status" aria-live="polite" from load and a spawned toast carries no role of its own (one live region, present before content arrives; the APG shape). Never role="alert": errors are not toasts and announce at once through Alert (4.1.3). RULED s307-D54, Dave by click 2026-09-28, verbatim: 'Announce politely for news, at once only for errors; Claude settles the six' (#313 A5).
accessibility.name: Dismiss carries aria-label="Dismiss message"; glyphs aria-hidden — message text carries meaning (colour never sole channel).
accessibility.keyboard: Action and dismiss are tabbable; focus-within pauses the auto-timer so keyboard users are never raced (2.2.1).
accessibility.focus: Visible :focus-visible outlines (2px currentColor) on action and dismiss.
accessibility.nonText: Status glyphs ≥3:1 vs the raised surface in both modes (1.4.11); internal marks knock out to the surface.

antiPatterns: An error toast (errors persist — use Alert with role="alert")
An action that exists ONLY in the toast (missable by design — Undo must also live in the persistent UI)
Auto-dismiss with no dismiss control and no pause-on-hover/focus
role="alert" / assertive announcement for a polite confirmation
Re-implementing press physics locally on action/dismiss (ADR-0013 ratchet)
